definitions.gloss: to make light of; to underestimate; to belittle; to disregard
definitions.explanation: To treat something as less important or serious than it actually is. To fail to give proper weight or attention to something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽視|けいし}して⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。

examples.english: It's not good to belittle the other person's opinions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽視|けいし}した⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: As a result of neglecting my health, I ended up with a serious illness.

notes: Common collocations: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽視|けいし}する (to disregard safety), ⟦{人権|じんけん}→人権：05416_jinken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽視|けいし}する (to belittle human rights), ⟦{軽視|けいし}できない→軽視する：25406_keishisuru⟧ (cannot be taken lightly). The antonym is ⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧ (to regard as important, to emphasize). Related: ⟦{無視|むし}する→無視する：17288_mushisuru⟧ (to ignore — stronger, implies complete disregard), ⟦{見下|みくだ}す→見下す：09911_mikudasu⟧ (to look down on — directed at people), ⟦{侮|あなど}る→侮る：10884_anadoru⟧ (to underestimate — implies contemptuous dismissal).
